annotations.title: Set how often tracked queries are checked

description: Change how often up to 100 tracked queries are checked: daily, weekly or monthly. A lower frequency spends less budget; use get_usage to see the effect. Checks skipped at a lower frequency are never made up later. Each one that cannot be changed is reported in "failed". Safe to retry.
name: set_tracked_query_check_frequency
title: Set how often tracked queries are checked
